_comment: Vocabulary the gate scans for on its own, independently of how the AI classified each decision. The two lists are UNIONed, not intersected - the agent cannot clear its own stop by calling something 일반. False positives cost one question; a miss costs a leak or a payout, so lean inclusive. Grow these per project.
_schema_note: Matching is case-insensitive substring on the decision text and on the spec section heading it belongs to.
